title: BCIR training corpus distillation record (Tier 3)
description: One supervised training example. The load-bearing rule is `verified_by`: a record may only exist if some gate in this repository checks the assistant turn. A distillation record whose answer nothing verifies is a hallucination with provenance attached, and it is worse than no record at all because it looks sourced.

record_id.description: sha256 over the canonical identity tuple (subject, task, messages). Content-addressed and stable.

task.description: claim = a machine-checked fact stated as Q/A; exercise = write the artifact; repair = fix a rejected artifact; prediction = state what a transform produces; review = diagnose without editing.

messages.description: Chat-format turns. Exactly one system, one user, one assistant, in that order -- a shape every supervised-fine-tuning pipeline accepts without a converter.

verified_by.description: The gate that checks this record's answer, and the specific claim it checks. Required, never empty: this is what separates a training record from an assertion.
